summary: Validated bug fix for session persistence (sessionStorage) in PGMEI iframe app. All 8 scenarios passed: initial login with 37411286000108 shows LUCI SCHIAVI..., 3 consecutive page reloads keep user logged in (no login screen), Sair clears session and reload stays on login, re-login with 33648223000119 shows SILVANI GONCALVES MACHADO (no leak from previous session), direct access to /pgmei3.html in a clean browser context redirects to /pgmei.html, Emitir Guia -> Inicio preserves CNPJ, year combo has 2021-2026.
critical_code_review_comments: pgmei-shared.js: ajustarLinksNavbar attaches a click listener on 'Sair' to clear sessionStorage but the href is also set to /pgmei.html. Works correctly, but note: if a user middle-clicks or opens Sair in a new tab, sessionStorage won't be cleared because the click listener won't fire; however this is acceptable for the study clone.
pgmei.html DOMContentLoaded redirects to /pgmei2.html when sessionStorage has 14-digit CNPJ. Good. Uses window.location.replace so back-button doesn't trap user on login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session persistence via sessionStorage ('pgmei_cnpj') is working across refresh, logout clears it, route protection on /pgmei3.html works in clean context. All regressions (dropdown, year combo 2021-2026, nav links) still pass.
